header.name: InvUI for Bedrock Resource Pack (EXPERIMENTAL / UNVERIFIED)
header.description: EXPERIMENTAL, ENABLED BY DEFAULT, NOT VERIFIED IN-GAME. ui/_ui_defs.json registers invui.json, invui_connect.json and invui_connect_data_driven.json. The connection inserts the invui_probe overlay into data_driven_container.desktop_panel and pocket_panel, so it may affect ALL screens that use those panels (possibly ordinary containers), not only VirtualContainer; vanilla chest_screen is not edited. No input suppression, item protection or close handling is implemented, and the probe button is not wired to any script. The pack version [0,1,0] and min_engine_version [1,26,70] are placeholders; the matching game version is unconfirmed. Test only in a disposable world with backups.
